d: We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Accountant to manage financial records, oversee accounting activities, and support accurate financial reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, excellent numerical skills, and the ability to maintain financial accuracy while supporting business operations.
Manage daily accounting transactions and maintain accurate financial records.
Prepare journal entries and maintain general ledger accounts.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payment processing.
Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports.
Perform bank reconciliations and account balance reviews.
Monitor cash flow, expenses, income, and financial transactions.
Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
Manage month-end and year-end closing activities.
Ensure invoices, receipts, and supporting documents are properly recorded.
Coordinate with auditors, tax agents, banks, and relevant stakeholders.
Ensure accounting practices comply with applicable standards and regulations.
Identify opportunities to improve financial controls and accounting procedures.
Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Understanding of general ledger, reconciliation, and bookkeeping procedures.
Familiarity with accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Good organizational and time management abilities.
Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.
Opportunities to contribute to financial management and reporting.
Exposure to various accounting and business operations.
Opportunities for continuous learning and development.
💡 Manage the Numbers. Maintain Accuracy. Build Financial Confidence!
If you are passionate about accounting and committed to financial excellence, we would love to hear from you!
